cached.note: Signal is unchanged from last week and none of it is about the show: an 827-upvote r/entertainment thread Oct 21 on refusing to boycott the Tonight Show over the Conor McGregor interview, plus 275 and 126-upvote r/ireland threads Oct 20 and 21 on her US TV debut. The rest is Celebrity Traitors UK wardrobe talk. The Town Hall Nov 7 Pinotphile taping is the part a reader can act on.

The live thread is his new book, Brut | Whiskey Ginger, on a current tour: a 38-point r/chubbybehemoth post Oct 30 and a 34-point r/AreYouGarbagePod episode Nov 1 where he talks about developing a show for Foley. Hacker News was a wall of Sam Altman false positives, so his Bell House Nov 5 date stands on the event page and the book tour.

Two live threads and neither is about New York: a Nov 3 r/PodcastSnarks post on him roasting comics who backed Trump, and a Nov 2 r/SymbyNews item on the Richard Lewis Award at the Comedy Gives Back gala. The rest is a Six Feet Under cameo question and a Pittsburgh spare ticket, so the Beacon Theatre Nov 8 date stands on the venue page.
